result.inventory_notes:
SCOPE AND METHOD. Audited in the worktree /Users/mattkovalik/promonight-web-cfb (branch feature/cfb-depth @ b247186; main @ d9d5eee). Read every file under src/app/cfb, src/components/cfb, src/lib/cfb plus the listed cross-site files, and grepped src/ for 2-3 digit literals and number words. Live-data facts were cross-checked with a READ-ONLY firebase-admin script (no writes): cfbSchools 87, cfbVenues 86, cfbRivalries 212, cfbGames 670 (662 non-tombstoned); all 32 MATCHUP_REGISTRY entries resolve to a cfbRivalries doc and all 32 have a 2026 game; 17 of 32 fall in the Rivalry Week window 2026-11-21..29 (16 of those on 2026-11-26..29); 25 of 32 carry a trophy; 0 registry rivalries have a null seriesStartYear; only washington-state (6 games, no venueId) is below the index floor (so sitemap 86 vs hub 87 is explained by the noindex predicate, not a literal).

RESULT ON THE HOUSE RULE. No hardcoded COUNT reaches the DOM, JSON-LD, <title>, meta description, aria-label or llms.txt on any CFB surface. Every rendered count is derived at render time from one of three sources: (1) cfbSchools collection size -> hub totalTeams (hub-data.ts:190) and cfbSchoolCount (get-coverage-counts.ts:16-17 -> coverage-counts.ts:73-98) feeding HomeHero.tsx:67, page.tsx:357, homepage-json-ld.tsx:21/68/81, llms.txt:21/31, about-copy.ts:102/110/244/333; (2) getMatchupIndex().length (matchups.ts:124-149, static 32-entry registry filtered against live cfbRivalries) feeding /cfb page.tsx:112, llms.txt:31/43, and via getMatchupIndexRows the /cfb/rivalries h2 (page.tsx:214), day/month/week labels (:107/:125/:192), ItemList numberOfItems + itemListElement (rivalry-jsonld.ts:51-57, 32 == 32 by construction), and the three FAQ answers (rivalry-index.ts:66/72/78, visible + FAQPage); (3) per-school cfbGames/cfbVenues data feeding the school-page stat strip (CfbSchoolPage.tsx:73/110), capacity (:135), Wk N (CfbSchedule.tsx:37), and per-matchup seriesStartYear/trophyCreatedYear (RivalryMatchupPage.tsx:283/295). Countdown 'IN N DAYS' (blocks.tsx:88) and 'WEEK N' (page.tsx:55 via hub-data.ts:199-204, clock vs hardcoded seasonStart '2026-08-24', capped at 15) are computed, not stored. No aria-label carries a count (CfbSchoolPage.tsx:159 '{shortName} rivalry guides', blocks.tsx:64 '{block.name} 2026', HubVenueLinks.tsx:43). No CFB <title> or meta description carries a count; the hub description deliberately dropped its count (metadata.ts:189-191 records the earlier 'all 86 teams' drift). School JSON-LD (SportsTeam) and matchup JSON-LD (BreadcrumbList + SportsEvent) emit no counts. The matchup registry (matchup-registry.ts:31-73) has exactly 32 entries and no copy anywhere states its size as a literal; the '32'/'~30'/'28' figures appear only in comments.

THE ONE FLAGGED ITEM is not a count but a hardcoded numeric literal that renders and contradicts live data: hub-data.ts:66 est '1904' for Florida vs Georgia renders as 'EST. 1904' (blocks.tsx:75) while cfbRivalries/florida--georgia.seriesStartYear = 1915 renders as 'Series began 1915' on the linked /cfb/rivalries/florida-georgia page. The three sibling literals (1897/1893/1900) match Firestore today but are the same unbacked pattern; the curated fallbackDate literals are latent (all four pairings have live game docs). Other hardcoded non-count copy in NATIONAL_CURATED that renders: host strings 'rotates', 'Dallas (neutral)', 'Jacksonville' and the blurbs (hub-data.ts:63-66).

OTHER NON-COUNT INVENTORY. Season-year literal 2026 by house rule in: page.tsx:68 eyebrow, metadata.ts:24 (all school titles/descriptions), :187 hub title, :264-266 index title/description, rivalry-jsonld.ts:20 (ItemList names, breadcrumb, SportsEvent name), RivalryMatchupPage.tsx:18 (H1, 'Not scheduled in 2026'), rivalries/page.tsx:171/186. Date-span prose duplicating RIVALRY_WEEK_START/END as literals: rivalries/page.tsx:196 and rivalry-index.ts:72 (also FAQPage JSON-LD). Latent unbacked claim: matchup-description.ts:99-100 'Series history, past results' for a dormant rivalry (no results data exists; branch unreachable today). about-copy.ts:333 hand-types 'MLB, NBA, NHL and MLS' instead of appLeagueList. Sitemap rivalry URLs derive from the static registry (getAllMatchupSlugs) while every other rivalry count derives from getMatchupIndex; they agree today (32/32) but would diverge if a rivalry doc were deleted. cfbTraditions (2 docs) is read by nothing on these surfaces; the hub THEME_CURATED list (hub-data.ts:74-79) is a curated name list with no dates and no counts, and CfbSchedule renders themeDesignations only when verified. Stale numeric comments ('86' where the corpus is 87) are listed in the last finding; none render.

verdict.reasoning: Verified in worktree /Users/mattkovalik/promonight-web-cfb (branch feature/cfb-depth). src/lib/cfb/hub-data.ts:66 contains the exact literal `est: '1904'` inside NATIONAL_CURATED (lines 62-67); the interface comment at line 53-54 explicitly says name/host/est/blurb are "human-curated editorial". getCfbHubData (hub-data.ts:150-170) spreads the curated object unchanged (`return { ...n, home, away, date }`) after overriding only `name` via resolveMatchupDisplayName; `est` is never read from cfbRivalries. src/components/cfb/hub/blocks.tsx:75 renders `{block.est ? ` · EST. ${block.est}` : ''}` into visible DOM on /cfb (page.tsx:102 maps data.national to NationalBlock), and /cfb is a live, indexable hub (league-hubs.ts:36 live:true, sitemap-registered, no robots/noindex in src/app/cfb/page.tsx). result.inventory_notes:
WORKTREE: /Users/mattkovalik/promonight-web-cfb (branch feature/cfb-depth, clean). All file paths above are relative to that root. No file was edited; no git state changed; Firestore was only read.

DATA PROBE (read-only, scratchpad script /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-mattkovalik-promonight-web/f00b72c2-50c4-4b45-ac53-44b4fc955698/scratchpad/cfb-probe.ts, run with the main checkout's .env.local credentials), supplementing the facts supplied:
- cfbSchools.editorialStatus: auto on 87/87. No school is 'destination', so every destination-only block and the destination description tier are dead today.
- cfbGames.themeDesignations: non-empty on 0/670 (verified or not). The CfbSchedule theme pill has never had anything to render.
- cfbTraditions: checker-neyland {tennessee, kind themeGame, dressCode 'Orange/white checkerboard by section', recurring true, editoriallySeeded false, no narrative}; shamrock-series {notre-dame, kind themeGame, dressCode null, recurring true, editoriallySeeded false, no narrative}. NOTHING in src/ reads this collection (grep: only scripts/cfb/run-phase1.ts writes it). The hub's curated 'Checker Neyland' card is the only overlap, and it is a hardcoded string, not a read.
- cfbRivalries: 212 docs; narrative on 0; seriesStartYear numeric on 212; trophyCreatedYear numeric on 11; trophy non-null on 88.
- MATCHUP_REGISTRY: 32 slugs (sitemap's 33 rivalry URLs = /cfb/rivalries + 32). All 32 rivalry docs exist and all 32 have a 2026 cfbGames doc, so every dormant/'Not in 2026'/'Not scheduled in 2026' branch is dead today (rivalries/page.tsx:65, RivalryMatchupPage.tsx:234, rivalry-index.ts:144, matchup-description.ts:96-106).
- 7/32 registry rivalries have trophy null: the-game, palmetto-bowl, third-saturday-in-october, lone-star-showdown, deep-souths-oldest-rivalry, holy-war, farmageddon.
- Hub curated est vs data seriesStartYear: the-game 1897/1897, iron-bowl 1893/1893, red-river 1900/1900, cocktail-party 1904/1915 (MISMATCH).
- 8 tombstoned cfbGames docs are filtered by isVisibleGame (data.ts:196).

HOW CfbSchoolPage / cfb-bits HANDLE traditionIds AND themeDesignations (task item a): CfbSchoolPage never touches school.traditionIds at all (no reference anywhere in src/components or src/lib/cfb outside the type). The editorial object is not read from Firestore; data.ts:311 returns a constant {signatureGameId:null, traditions:[], gamedayCulture:null, whyYouGo:null, venueInTheirWords:null, contributor:null} for every school, so the Signature Game / Why you go / Gameday & Traditions / venue-prose / contributor-credit blocks (CfbSchoolPage.tsx:198, 227, 291, 376, 398) are unreachable. When 'empty' they render nothing, no heading, no placeholder. themeDesignations flow only through data.ts:293-295 -> CfbGameView.themes -> CfbSchedule.tsx:64-72 pills, verified-gated, and currently empty on every row. cfb-bits.tsx TrophyTag renders the registry display name with the trophy in the title attribute (line 49), all from cfbRivalries.

KEYWORD SWEEP (tradition, ritual, whiteout, blackout, stripe, checker, theme night, dress code, pageantry, trophy, series) across the CFB tree plus sitemap.ts, llms.txt/route.ts, HomeHero.tsx, BrandBarLeagueHubs.tsx, Footer.tsx, footer.tsx, team-grid.tsx, teams-browser.tsx, league-hubs.ts, about-copy.ts, coverage-counts.ts, get-coverage-counts.ts, globals.css: every user-facing hit is accounted for in the findings. Remaining hits are code comments, type names, the CSS @theme directive, the CfbThemePersist colour-theme component (colour, not theme night), and the pro 'Theme nights' footer/homepage/llms bullets that attach to the pro team count, never to CFB. 'dress code', 'pageantry', 'ritual', 'blackout', 'stripe' do not appear in any rendered CFB string; 'whiteout' appears only in the contribute form placeholder and the hub's hardcoded 'White Out' card; 'checker' only in the hub's hardcoded 'Checker Neyland' card and the unread tradition doc.

COUNTS (house rule 'no hardcoded counts'): every rendered CFB count is derived: totalTeams (schoolsSnap.size), matchupCount / 'All N rivalries' (getMatchupIndex length, shared by hub, index h2, llms.txt), rivalry-week and month group counts (row lengths), FAQ counts (rows), home/road/rivalries stat strip (games), ItemList numberOfItems (rows.length). Hardcoded numerals in comments only ('7 of 32', '32 pages', '41 schools', '11 of 212') are not rendered. The hub meta description deliberately carries no count (metadata.ts:189-191 comment). cfbSchoolCount = 87 sitewide (llms.txt, HomeHero, about) while 86 school pages are indexable/sitemapped; that is the documented house rule, not a defect.

HARDCODED NON-COUNT FACTS RENDERED IN DOM (all in hub-data.ts NATIONAL_CURATED lines 63-66 and THEME_CURATED lines 74-79, plus page-extras.ts CFB_KICKERS lines 130-146): est years, hosts, trophy, blurbs, fallback dates, theme names, chants. The weekly rail on the same hub page derives trophy/name/date from Firestore, so the two rails disagree in method.

EM DASHES in user-facing CFB copy (separate house rule, noted in passing): CfbSchoolPage.tsx:389, contribute/page.tsx:37, ContributeForm.tsx:29 (error strings), :30, :36, :64, :70, :87.

JSON-LD SURFACES CHECKED: /cfb/rivalries CollectionPage + ItemList + FAQPage (rivalry-jsonld.ts:32-72); /cfb/rivalries/[slug] BreadcrumbList + SportsEvent (rivalry-jsonld.ts:104-187); /cfb/[school] SportsTeam ([school]/page.tsx:55-61); /cfb hub emits no JSON-LD.
